outcome: Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-Short Form 20 (PFDI-20) score
Pelvic Organ Prolapse Distress Inventory 6 (POPDI-6) score
cohort: The study included 184 twin primiparas who attended the pelvic floor rehabilitation system of the First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University between January 2020 and October 2021.
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain in twin primiparas was positively correlated with the prevalence of pelvic floor dysfunction (including abnormal vaginal dynamic pressure, injured type I muscle fibers, anterior vaginal wall prolapse, and stress urinary incontinence) but did not exacerbate subjective pelvic floor symptoms as measured by common distress inventories.
